gen-gf-warnes-fs-trench-slab: Expressive is Warnes, with stretched, spacious tracking and strokes of exactly no contrast. And Trench Slab, a classic serif, keeps its lowercase tight to its capitals, doing quiet dignified work where the heading shouts.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-domine: Texture like neatly bent pipe cleaner defines Warnes, its ink strokes tapering out before they touch. But Domine, a text serif, brings middle-of-the-road contrast and curves with room inside, and that difference is the draw.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-esteban: Stretched, spacious, bent-wire bold: that's Warnes, its bowls never thinning at the sides. Then Esteban, a text serif, brings soft contrast and an e that never squeezes shut, so Warnes feels blunter beside it.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-faustina: Classic Faustina, a serif with an open-jawed c, thins its bowls gracefully against Warnes's ruler-straight strokes. And the pair's pull comes from that slight brush-like pressure set against rigid lines.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-halant: Authoritative Halant, a serif with a towering x-height, sits under Warnes, whose stylus-at-fixed-pressure strokes taper out before touching. But Halant's faint stroke shifts would carry paragraphs with traditional, unhurried steadiness.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-headland-one: Warnes holds its strokes at no contrast at all, stretched wide and spaciously tracked, with ink ends that taper before touching. Headland One, a text serif, feels gentler and more traditional beside it.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Hedvig Letters Serif brings authority, with open-ended curves that lighten mildly and a sturdy, tall body. Hedvig Letters Serif holds the text while Warnes earns its keep big and short, with constant bent-wire strokes.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-lisu-bosa: Lisu Bosa is a text serif with sturdy, tall lowercase. Its stems outweigh hairlines only a little, so Warnes, built like bent tubing with spacious tracking, supplies all the drama.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-marcellus-sc: Warnes draws its strokes at constant pressure, tapering before they touch. Marcellus SC, a classic serif, would read with dignified, literary restraint across paragraphs, its terminals pulled back and its strokes gently modulated.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-montagu-slab: Bold, stretched Warnes keeps its strokes flat in weight, with no brush swelling. Montagu Slab, a text serif, adds modest engraved-brass contrast and a sizable x-height, and that gap is the pair's hook.
